shortDescription: Train your mind daily. Stay consistent.

level_30.title: ZYNEXON
level_30.desc: Reach Level 30. The final rank. The war is won.

landingPageCopy.heroSubHeadline: {appName} is a daily discipline system — tasks, brain training, and deep work timers — built for people who are tired of knowing what to do and still not doing it.
landingPageCopy.heroSubCTA: No signup needed. See your score instantly.
problemBullets: You know what you should be doing every day. You just don't do it consistently.
You make plans on Sunday night. By Wednesday they're gone.
You open your phone to study. You close it 40 minutes later having done nothing.
landingPageCopy.problemCallout: {appName} makes every day binary — you either won it or you lost it. No grey area. No excuses.

featureCards.title: Daily Tasks
featureCards.desc: 5 discipline-focused tasks every day, tailored to your focus area — study, fitness, work, logic, or mental resilience. Miss them and your streak breaks.

featureCards.title: Brain Training
featureCards.desc: 10 games that sharpen focus, working memory, reaction speed, and pattern recognition. 5 minutes a day compounds into a measurably sharper mind.

featureCards.title: War Mode
featureCards.desc: Lock in for 25, 45, or 60 minutes of deep work. Phone down. Timer running. XP only lands if you actually show up — it runs on the honour system.

featureCards.title: Daily Journal
featureCards.desc: Rate your mood and energy each day. Set one objective for tomorrow. The honesty compounds — patterns in your performance become visible over time.

landingPageCopy.streakDescription: Every day you complete tasks, your streak grows. Skip one day — it resets to zero. That single rule creates a daily urgency that no notification can replicate.
landingPageCopy.streakVisualLabel: 6-day streak — one task today keeps it alive
landingPageCopy.streakShieldCopy: Streak Shields protect you from one missed day — earn them by completing perfect weeks.
landingPageCopy.weeklyReportCopy: Weekly War Report every Sunday — grade, XP breakdown, rank change, verdict.
landingPageCopy.rankMilestoneCopy: Reach XP milestones to unlock new ranks. Level 30 = {appName}. Less than 1% will get there.
landingPageCopy.rankDescription: 30 ranks. Each one earned through XP. Every day you show up moves you forward.

dailyLoopSteps.title: Choose your focus
dailyLoopSteps.body: Study, Fitness, Work, Discipline, or Logic. Your daily tasks are generated around it.

dailyLoopSteps.title: Complete 5 tasks
dailyLoopSteps.body: Each task is specific and actionable. No vague goals. Either you did it or you didn't.

dailyLoopSteps.title: Train your brain
dailyLoopSteps.body: Run through one or two games from the Training Hub. Each takes under 5 minutes.

dailyLoopSteps.title: Log your day
dailyLoopSteps.body: Rate your mood and energy. Set tomorrow's objective. Takes 30 seconds.

dailyLoopSteps.title: Protect your streak
dailyLoopSteps.body: Don't break it. If you do, shields can save you. Earn shields by completing perfect weeks.

landingPageCopy.gameDemoDesc: Solve as many arithmetic problems as you can in 30 seconds. Free to try — no account needed.
landingPageCopy.finalCTAHeadline: Are you in or are you out?
landingPageCopy.finalCTABody: Free to start. No credit card. Takes less than 60 seconds to create an account and get your first 5 tasks.
landingPageCopy.finalCTAFooter: {count} other {streakUnitLabelPlural} who chose discipline over excuses.

authPageCopy.heroParagraph: Most people talk about discipline. You're about to practice it.

weeklyReportCopy.pushPrompt: Get your weekly war report delivered every Sunday.

levelUpCopy.level10Plus: Captain rank earned. Lead from the front and keep climbing.

shieldModalCopy.title: 🛡️ Streak Shield
shieldModalCopy.usedFooter: {count} shield(s) remaining. Don't make it a habit.
shieldModalCopy.howItWorks: Miss a day. Keep your streak. That's what a Shield does — it activates automatically, no action needed.
shieldModalCopy.limitation: Shields do not cover 2+ missed days. Miss two in a row and your streak resets regardless of how many shields you have.

earnMethods.title: Perfect Week
earnMethods.desc: Complete all 5 tasks for 7 days straight.

earnMethods.title: XP Milestone
earnMethods.desc: Every 500 XP earned grants one Shield.

earnMethods.title: Full War
earnMethods.desc: Complete a 60-min Full War Mode session.

shieldModalCopy.maxNote: You can hold a maximum of 3 Shields at once. Earn them before you need them.
shieldModalCopy.integrityNote: The XP means nothing if you didn't earn it.

ranksModalCopy.title: ⚔️ Ranks
ranksModalCopy.intro: Every XP you earn advances your rank. Ranks are earned — not given.
ranksModalCopy.xpSources: XP is gained through daily tasks, training games, War Mode, and your journal. The more consistent you are, the faster you climb.

warModeModalCopy.title: ⚔️ War Mode
warModeModalCopy.intro: War Mode is a timed focus session. You commit to a block of deep work, lock your phone, and earn XP when you finish.
warModeModalCopy.outsideApp: The work happens outside the app — on your laptop, your notebook, wherever. {appName} just holds you accountable and rewards you for showing up.

sessions.name: Full War
sessions.desc: Maximum effort. Earns a Streak Shield.

warModeModalCopy.honourNote: War Mode runs on the honour system. The XP means nothing if you didn't earn it. Your discipline is between you and yourself.
warModeModalCopy.lockScreenNote: Lock your screen. The timer runs in the background.

warModeEntryCopy.title: Enter War Mode

warModeEntryCopy.integrityNote: This only works if you're honest with yourself. The XP means nothing if you didn't earn it.
